related.title: seL4：能力權限與最小授權
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：研究5驗收：交付trap流程及邊界測試矩陣；只在離線模型或自己的xv6教學環境操作。 請保留本研究的輸入、逐筆中間狀態與不符合條件時的處置。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Investigation 5 acceptance: Deliver the trap flow and boundary-test matrix; work only in the offline model or an owned xv6 teaching environment. Retain inputs, intermediate state and the disposition when the criterion is not met.
related.difference: 畫能力衍生樹與endpoint；建立principal、object、right矩陣，為每項訊息行為列最小需求。
related.differenceEn: Draw the capability derivation tree and endpoint; tabulate principal, object and right with each message’s minimum requirements.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
系統呼叫經trap轉入核心；使用者傳入的位址仍需檢查。教學核心揭露機制，不等同正式平台安全保證。
本課數值核對：8188+8-8192 = 4 B；另一項核對：8192-8188 = 4 B。兩項若屬不同量綱，不得直接相除或相減。

能力同時識別物件與可行權限；衍生能力不能超出原能力授權。撤銷與刪除的物件關係須明確。
本課數值核對：3-1 = 2 removed_rights；另一項核對：1/3 = 0.333333333333 remaining_ratio。兩項若屬不同量綱，不得直接相除或相減。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
A system call traps into the kernel; user-supplied addresses still require validation. A teaching kernel reveals mechanisms, not production security guarantees.
Numeric audit: 8188+8-8192 = 4 B; second audit: 8192-8188 = 4 B. Quantities with different dimensions must not be directly divided or subtracted.

A capability identifies an object and allowed rights; a derived capability must not exceed its authority. Distinguish the object relationships of revoke and delete.
Numeric audit: 3-1 = 2 removed_rights; second audit: 1/3 = 0.333333333333 remaining_ratio. Quantities with different dimensions must not be directly divided or subtracted.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Linux epoll：邊緣觸發與排空規則
related.titleEn: Linux epoll: edge-triggering and drain rules
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：研究5驗收：交付trap流程及邊界測試矩陣；只在離線模型或自己的xv6教學環境操作。 請保留本研究的輸入、逐筆中間狀態與不符合條件時的處置。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Investigation 5 acceptance: Deliver the trap flow and boundary-test matrix; work only in the offline model or an owned xv6 teaching environment. Retain inputs, intermediate state and the disposition when the criterion is not met.
related.difference: 以ready布林、佇列長度與event計數建狀態機；區分短讀、EOF及EAGAIN。
related.differenceEn: Model ready state, queue length and event count, distinguishing short reads, EOF and EAGAIN.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
系統呼叫經trap轉入核心；使用者傳入的位址仍需檢查。教學核心揭露機制，不等同正式平台安全保證。
本課數值核對：8188+8-8192 = 4 B；另一項核對：8192-8188 = 4 B。兩項若屬不同量綱，不得直接相除或相減。

邊緣觸發通知狀態變化；非阻塞讀者通常需讀到EAGAIN才能等待下一次事件。一次事件不等於一筆訊息。
本課數值核對：ceil(10/4) = 3 reads；另一項核對：10-4 = 6 remaining_B。兩項若屬不同量綱，不得直接相除或相減。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
A system call traps into the kernel; user-supplied addresses still require validation. A teaching kernel reveals mechanisms, not production security guarantees.
Numeric audit: 8188+8-8192 = 4 B; second audit: 8192-8188 = 4 B. Quantities with different dimensions must not be directly divided or subtracted.

Edge-triggered notification reports state changes; a nonblocking reader generally drains to EAGAIN before waiting again. One event is not one message.
Numeric audit: ceil(10/4) = 3 reads; second audit: 10-4 = 6 remaining_B. Quantities with different dimensions must not be directly divided or subtracted.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
